notInstalled.title: Flint completes tasks in your browser
notInstalled.description: Install the extension to give Flint browser access

deleteServer.title: Delete MCP Server
deleteServer.description: Delete the MCP server {{serverName}}? Flint stops it and removes its configuration. This action cannot be undone.
deleteServer.approvalsRemoved: Every approval you gave this server is removed, along with its stored sign-in. A server you add later with the same name starts with no approvals. Your record of past decisions is kept.
deleteServer.disableInstead: To keep the configuration and its approvals but stop using the server, turn it off instead.
deleteServer.forgetFailed: {{serverName}} was deleted, but Flint could not remove its approvals or sign-in

renameServer.approvalsReset: Approvals for {{oldName}} do not carry over to {{newName}}
renameServer.approvalsResetDesc: Its stored sign-in was also cleared. Flint asks again before using its tools.
renameServer.forgetFailed: {{oldName}} was renamed, but Flint could not remove the approvals or sign-in stored under the old name

approval.changedSinceApproval: Configuration changed since you approved it. Turn auto-approve on again to renew.

validation.nameDuplicate: A server with this name already exists.
validation.nameInvalidChars: The name cannot contain "::" or control characters.
validation.commandRequired: Enter the command that starts the server, for example npx or uvx.
validation.commandHasSpaces: The command contains spaces. If this is a whole command line, put only the program here and add the rest as arguments.
validation.argUnbalancedQuotes: This argument has an unmatched quote. Arguments are passed as-is, without a shell, so quotes are not removed.
validation.urlInvalid: This is not a valid URL.
validation.urlScheme: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
validation.timeoutInvalid: Enter a whole number of seconds greater than 0, or leave it empty.
validation.headerNameRequired: Enter a header name for this value.
validation.headerNameInvalid: Header names cannot contain spaces or special characters.
validation.envKeyRequired: Enter a variable name for this value.
validation.envKeyInvalid: Use letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit.
validation.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields to save.

nextStep.checkCommand: Check that the command is installed and can be found on your PATH, then turn the server on again.
nextStep.checkUrl: Check that the URL is correct and the server is reachable, then turn it on again.
nextStep.authorize: Sign in to this server, then turn it on again.
nextStep.retry: Turn the server on again to retry.

connection.notListedAfterStart: The server started but is not listed as connected.
connection.toolsNone: Connected, but this server offers no tools.
connection.toolsWhenConnected: Its tools become available once it is connected.
connection.appliesToChats: Tools reach a chat only when the chat's selected model supports tools. Individual tools can be switched off from the tools menu in the chat input, and those switches apply to all chats.

details.noDescription: No description was provided for this server.
details.runsWhereLocalProcess: Runs a program on this computer with your user permissions.
details.runsWhereLocalEndpoint: Connects to a server on this computer or your local network ({{host}}).
details.runsWhereUnresolved: Connects to {{host}}. Whether that is on your network depends on how the name resolves.
details.externalYes: Tool requests, including what you ask it to act on, are sent to that service.
details.externalDepends: Flint cannot see what the server does, so the server itself may contact other services.
details.setupAuthorization: Sign in to this server. Current state: {{state}}.
details.setupBrowserExtension: Install the Flint Browser Extension in a Chrome-based browser.
details.usageExample: Once it is connected, ask in a chat for something its tools can do. Flint asks before calling a tool unless you have allowed it.
details.effects: Turn off, clear sign-in, or delete
details.effectDisable: Turn off: stays configured but is not started, so its tools are unavailable in every chat. Approvals are kept.
details.effectClearAuth: Clear authentication: forgets the stored sign-in and disconnects. The server stays on, keeps its approvals, and reconnects after you sign in again.
details.effectRemove: Delete: stops the server, removes its configuration, and removes every approval and stored sign-in it had. Renaming it also resets approvals, and changing its command, arguments, URL, environment or header names means approving it again.
details.generateLabel: Generate a description for {{serverName}} with AI

editJson.title: Edit JSON for MCP Server: {{serverName}}
editJson.errorPaste: Invalid JSON format in pasted content
editJson.errorServerName: Server name is required and cannot be empty
editJson.errorMissingServerNameKey: JSON must be structured as {"serverName": {config}} - missing server name key
editJson.errorInvalidType: Invalid type '{{type}}' for server '{{serverName}}'. Type must be 'stdio', 'http', or 'sse'
editJson.errorNameDuplicate: A server named '{{serverName}}' already exists. Edit that server instead, or use a different name.

checkParams: Please check the parameters according to the tutorial.
title: MCP Servers
allowPermissionsDesc: When enabled, all MCP tool calls will be automatically approved without showing permission dialogs. This setting applies globally to all conversations, including new chats.

runtimeSettings.title: Runtime Settings
runtimeSettings.description: Configure how Flint manages and retries MCP servers.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Maximum time to wait for an MCP tool response before timing out.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Longest tool result kept in the conversation. Anything past this is trimmed and marked as truncated, so one large result cannot exhaust the model's context. Set to 0 to keep results whole.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: When enabled, Flint selects relevant MCP servers before loading tools. Disable to always load the full MCP tool list.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModel: Use a dedicated model for routing
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: When smart routing is on, run the routing step with a separate (often smaller) model instead of the chat model. Turn off to always use the active chat model for routing.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Choose provider and model in one place. Only lightweight models are listed so routing stays fast and cheap.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: No lightweight models available. Add a smaller model or configure API keys in Models.

state.invalidScopes: invalid OAuth scopes in the configuration

auth.needsAuthHint: Sign in to this server to connect.

serverLog.title: Log for MCP server {{serverName}}
serverLog.description: What this server printed to its error stream, newest last. Secrets are removed before anything is written.
serverLog.empty: This server has not printed anything.

describe.title: Generate descriptions with AI
describe.settingDesc: Ask a model to write the "About this server" text from each server's tool list. You review every text before it is saved.
describe.intro: The chosen model receives each server's name and tool list (names, descriptions, arguments). Nothing is saved until you accept it.
describe.pending: Needs your decision: replaces your description
describe.skippedNoTools: tools unknown; turn the server on once so Flint can read them

selfApproval.note: This server can approve its own commands ({{names}}). Flint asks you about every call to these tools and never auto-approves them.

mention.offDesc: You mentioned it, but it isn't running, so its tools aren't available to this reply.
mention.enabled: {{serverName}} is on. Send your request again to use its tools.
